english:
Precision Hits with a <void Void /> Weapon within 3 seconds grant <void Volatile Rounds /> for <pve 10 /> <pvp [6] /> seconds, as do 3 <void Void /> Weapon Kills within 3 seconds.

Precision Hits required: 25% of the Magazine plus 1, rounded down. Bows require 2.

Triggering a <void Volatile /> detonation grants 10% Class Ability Energy.

source.text:
Upon scoring multiple Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each, or upon scoring 3 kills within 3 seconds of each with Void Weapons:

Grants Volatile Rounds for 10 [6] seconds.

Precision Hits trigger for Volatile Rounds: 
 (25% of Magazine Size) + 1, rounded down.
Bows: 2

Triggering a Volatile detonation grants 10% Class Ability Energy.
